## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow keys</kbd> | Move between years in the active page. |
| <kbd>Page Up</kbd> / <kbd>Page Down</kbd> | Move to the previous or next page of years. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Select the highlighted year. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the year grid without changing the value. |

## Accessibility

The labeled input and trigger own a paged year grid with selected, highlighted, and disabled cells.
